Ex-employee says Lilly promoted GLP-1 drug off-label

A former Eli Lilly sales rep filed a lawsuit alleging that she was fired after complaining that the company promoted its Mounjaro diabetes drug as a weight loss treatment before receiving regulatory approval to do so.
